sourceModId.description: Must resolve to an existing mods/<id>.json id -- this is a referential-integrity check the schema itself cannot express, run it as a separate cross-file validation pass after schema validation passes.

relativePath.description: Path to the exe, relative to the installed mod's root.

envVars.description: Cross-platform baseline, applied on every OS. platform.<os>.envVars ADDS to this set, never replaces it.

role.description: setup = one-shot generator run during install/update (Nemesis, FNIS, Synthesis patchers, etc). launcher = designates the exe GMM's Play button should launch; never auto-run during install.

autoRun.description: Only meaningful for role=setup. false registers the exe in GMM's normal exe list for manual invocation -- required default for anything genuinely interactive (e.g. BodySlide without a baked batch preset), since running it non-interactively would silently skip real user choices.

rerunOnModsetChange.description: Only meaningful when autoRun=true and role=setup. Re-fires this tool on any incremental update that changes mods it depends on. Skipping this is a correctness bug, not just a convenience gap -- stale generated output otherwise persists silently.

requiresVirtualFsVisible.description: True if the tool needs the full merged/deployed mod view before it can run correctly.

path.description: Where the tool writes, relative to its working directory.

argName.description: If the tool accepts an output-directory flag, GMM injects the instance's actual resolved absolute path here instead of trusting the tool's own default. This is the mechanism behind configurable output location -- it is resolved per-instance at run time, never baked into the pack.

capture.description: syntheticMod turns the output into a proper tracked mod (origin: generated in GMM's own state, fully replaced -- not merged -- on every run). inPlace leaves output wherever it lands, untracked.

steamOverlay.description: Maps onto LaunchParams.inject_steam_overlay, same as the manifest-level field.
